$comment: SO2H menu sheet manifest. Consumed by tools/so2h_gen_sheets.py, which emits
THE GRID IS NEVER INFERRED FROM PIXELS. Every sheet declares its unit and grid here and
the generator hard-fails if the declared grid does not divide the file exactly.
'run' is the cell band that a growing panel repeats or stretches through. It is a single
middle cell for every frame sheet on purpose: a one-cell band is used identically on every
row and every column, so 'A B B C D' grows as 'A B [B..] C D' and the interior row
'E F F F G' grows as 'E F [F..] F G' with no cross-row drift. A wider band would alternate
two different tiles on the rows where the band is not uniform (the bottom row 'L M N N O'
would come out 'L M N M N N O'), which is exactly the seam artefact this field exists to
avoid. Omit 'run' entirely for an atlas - a sheet with no run band never grows, it only
NOTHING IS RETIRED. All 43 legacy so2h_menu tiles stay registered below as 1x1 sheets so
no existing draw call goes dark. New sheets only give descriptor rows something better to
point at, one reversible line at a time.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetFrameFilled
sheets.note: Contentless-filled. The only textbook nine-slice of the five: tile map A B B C D / E F F F G / H F F F I / J F F F K / L M N N O, single self-tiling opaque interior F. Primary body panel.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetFrameEmpty
sheets.note: Empty_Frame. Its centre cell is fully transparent ON PURPOSE - this is the frame you put over live content - so hollowInterior waives the generator's transparent-run-cell check. Hand-packed with cross-row reuse (A B B C D / E F G H I / J K L J K / M N B O P / Q R G G S). Interior is decorated, not flat, so it grows well horizontally and is best kept near native height.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetFrameRaising
sheets.note: Raising_Window. 23 of 25 cells unique; top row A B B C D.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetFrameBacked
sheets.note: Backed_Frame. Same tile-identity map as Raising.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetFramePopup
sheets.note: Replacement-technicalUI_Popup. Genuinely a different frame, not a shifted copy: A B C C D / E F G H I / J K L M N / O P Q R S / T U U V W.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetSongBackdrop
sheets.note: Horizontal extendable strip. Rows 0 and 3 are fully transparent padding; rows 1-2 are cap + repeating middle + cap (B C C C C C C D / E F G G G G G H). No vertical run band - it was not drawn to grow downward.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetCornerFix
sheets.note: Atlas, 9 unique corner patches for where two panels meet. No repeated tiles.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetBigButton
sheets.note: Atlas, 4 button container states. No repeated tiles.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetContentBox
sheets.note: Atlas, 16 content-container pieces. No repeated tiles.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetMiniButton
sheets.note: Atlas, 16 mini-button and textbox pieces. No repeated tiles.

sheets.name: gSo2hSheetItems
sheets.note: The item and button icon atlas, 448x480, 167/210 cells unique. Addressed by So2h_Ui_Slice(sheet, col, row). No named slices yet: the sheet carries only 4 of the 6 medallions and no spiritual stones, and the decision was to source ALL medallions from the OoT rips behind a one-line art-source table rather than mix two art origins on one row.

legacyTiles.$comment: The 43 pieces cut by tools/so2h_slice_menu_sheet.py. Each is its own 1x1 sheet at its own native size; unit is taken from the file. KEEP - additive, never replaced.
